description: This Python source file implements an Azure Speech-to-Text (STT) service class for real-time audio transcription within the Pipecat project. It provides a class AzureSTTService that integrates with Azure Cognitive Services Speech SDK to handle speech recognition, including starting, stopping, and processing audio streams, as well as handling recognition events and transcriptions.

classes.name: AzureSTTService
classes.description: A class implementing speech-to-text services using Azure Cognitive Services, providing real-time audio transcription capabilities with methods to start, stop, cancel, and process audio streams.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, region: str, language: Language = Language.EN_US, sample_rate: Optional[int] = None, endpoint_id: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Azure STT service with API key, region, language, sample rate, and optional endpoint ID.

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Returns True, indicating this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_stt(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Async generator method that processes incoming audio bytes, writes to the audio stream, and yields error frames if exceptions occur.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Sets up the Azure speech recognizer and starts continuous recognition when given a StartFrame.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops recognition and cleans up resources upon receiving an EndFrame.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Immediately stops recognition and closes resources upon receiving a CancelFrame.

methods.name: _handle_transcription( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[Language] = None )
methods.description: Handles transcription results with tracing, invoked when recognition results are obtained.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognized(self, event)
methods.description: Event handler for recognized speech, processes the recognized text, and schedules transcripts handling.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognizing(self, event)
methods.description: Event handler for interim recognizing speech, processes partial transcription results.
